biggest_catch: Your friend has to do all three things in 60 days - open checking, receive $500+ in direct deposits, AND make 12+ debit transactions - or you get nothing.
catches: The referee must register via your referral link and, within 60 days of becoming a member, open a personal checking account AND complete one or more direct deposits totaling $500+ AND complete 12+ debit card transactions (transfers excluded).
Referrer can earn up to $500 in referral rewards in a calendar year (10 referrals).
Both referrer and referee receive the $50 reward only after all qualifying criteria are met.
New members only; eligibility limited to the credit union's membership field.
Full terms live on ReferLive (the credit union's official referral platform); see linked program terms for exclusions.

steps: Register for the Greenville FCU Member Referral Program on the credit union's website.
Receive your unique referral link and share it with friends and family.
Your referee registers using your link and becomes a member.

Within 60 days of becoming a member, the referee opens a personal checking account, completes direct deposits totaling $500 or more, and completes 12 or more debit card transactions (transfers excluded).
You receive a $50 reward - up to $500 in referral rewards per calendar year.
timing: $50 reward to both referrer and referee when the referee registers and completes all qualifying criteria within 60 days of becoming a member.

maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
